findings.description: Direct inspection of the current neutral, sit and crouch renders shows gray upper-thigh skin exposed below the skirt; the added white geometry still reads as a crotch patch rather than continuous wearable shorts with leg hems. The pose-matched surface-ray diagnostic now includes shorts-leg-cover-left/right and records only 17.29% under-shorts thigh coverage in sit and 25.54% in crouch on each side. No thigh coverage or fit acceptance is granted.

Direct inspection of the current front, back, left, right and three-quarter views shows dense rigid stepped side ridges and projecting hem corners. In sit and crouch, the front panel hangs between or behind the legs while the side panels splay into sharp triangular flaps.

The geometry audit and renders do not establish usable fit, calibrated weights, Shape Key response, UV completion, Unity/VRChat execution or release readiness. This prototype is rejected and remains non-releaseable.

nextAction: Replace the surface-copied thigh patches with a continuous assembled shorts shell that closes around both legs and through a crotch gusset. Rework overskirt side pleats and hem deformation. Rebuild from the canonical checkpoint, then inspect new pose-matched evidence and retain the rejection until all quality gates are independently met.
